title: A reply notice sent to a leader or a Space owner opens their own inbox instead of the staff-only page

source.ref: Email and messaging check 2026-11-18 (thread: Check every email and message system)

detail: 2026-11-18: notifyConversationReply (lib/comms/inbound.ts) writes reference_type 'conversation' for the conversation owner, and lib/notifications/href.ts sends 'conversation' to /admin/crm/conversations, which requires staff. Leaders (kind leader, inbox /lead/inbox) and Space owners (Space-lane threads under /spaces/[slug]/crm/conversations) are bounced by every reply bell. Same class as LIVE-505. Done when the bell row carries a destination the owner can open.

verify.note: Fails on main today; passes once the fix lands.
